name: smoke-bias
description: Harness acceptance test: ideal divider + PDK poly-R/nfet bias + diode-connected NPN. Not the LDO.
claim: None — harness self-verification, not a spec claim. Proves the PVT plumbing (parameter substitution, .lib corner sections, .temp) actually takes effect, so later records against ratified spec lines (#1) can be trusted.

operating_conditions.note: N/A — harness self-verification only, no load or output network involved (see sim/README.md's Operating conditions field)

vbias.description: diode-connected nfet_03v3 Vgs; the spread floor proves the MOS/res .lib sections change between corners

vbe.description: NPN Vbe at 10 uA over -40..125 C; the spread floor proves .temp is applied
